parameters.query:
with recursive

user_ctx as (
    select
        u.id as user_id,
        coalesce(
            s.base_currency,
            u.default_currency,
            'EUR'
        ) as base_currency
    from moneytrack.app_users u
    left join moneytrack.user_settings s
        on s.user_id = u.id
    where u.telegram_user_id =
          {{ $json.telegram_user_id }}::bigint
    limit 1
),

requested_account as (
    select
        a.id,
        a.currency_code
    from moneytrack.accounts a
    join user_ctx uc
        on uc.user_id = a.user_id
    where a.id::text = '{{ $json.account_id }}'
      and a.is_active = true
    limit 1
),

scope_accounts as (
    select ra.id
    from requested_account ra

    union all

    select child.id
    from moneytrack.accounts child
    join scope_accounts parent
        on child.parent_id = parent.id
    join user_ctx uc
        on uc.user_id = child.user_id
    where child.is_active = true
      and {{ $json.include_descendants ? 'true' : 'false' }}
),

filtered_transactions as (
    select
        t.id,
        t.transaction_type,
        t.account_id,
        a.name as account_name,

        t.amount_original,

        coalesce(
            nullif(t.currency_original, ''),
            a.currency_code,
            uc.base_currency
        ) as currency_original,

        t.category_id,
        t.description,
        t.transaction_date,

        uc.base_currency

    from moneytrack.transactions t

    join user_ctx uc
        on uc.user_id = t.user_id

    join scope_accounts sa
        on sa.id = t.account_id

    left join moneytrack.accounts a
        on a.id = t.account_id
       and a.user_id = t.user_id

    where t.transaction_date >=
          '{{ $json.date_from }}'::date

      and t.transaction_date <
          (
              '{{ $json.date_to }}'::date
              + interval '1 day'
          )
      and {{ $json.category_filter_predicate }}
),

converted_transactions as (
    select
        ft.*,

        case
            when ft.currency_original = ft.base_currency
                then abs(coalesce(ft.amount_original, 0))

            when source_rate.usd_rate is not null
             and base_rate.usd_rate is not null
             and source_rate.usd_rate <> 0

                then
                    abs(coalesce(ft.amount_original, 0))
                    * base_rate.usd_rate
                    / source_rate.usd_rate

            else null
        end as amount_base_effective,

        case
            when ft.transaction_type <> 'adjustment' then 0
            when ft.currency_original = ft.base_currency
                then coalesce(ft.amount_original, 0)
            when source_rate.usd_rate is not null
             and base_rate.usd_rate is not null
             and source_rate.usd_rate <> 0
                then
                    coalesce(ft.amount_original, 0)
                    * base_rate.usd_rate
                    / source_rate.usd_rate
            else null
        end as adjustment_base_effective

    from filtered_transactions ft

    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate
        from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = ft.currency_original
          and r.rate_date <= ft.transaction_date::date
        order by r.rate_date desc
        limit 1
    ) source_rate on true

    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate
        from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = ft.base_currency
          and r.rate_date <= ft.transaction_date::date
        order by r.rate_date desc
        limit 1
    ) base_rate on true
),

summary as (
    select
        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'income'
                    then amount_base_effective
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as income,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type in ('expense', 'adjustment')
                    then amount_base_effective
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as expense,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'income'
                    then abs(coalesce(amount_original, 0))
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as income_original,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'expense'
                    then abs(coalesce(amount_original, 0))
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as expense_original,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'adjustment'
                    then coalesce(amount_original, 0)
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as adjustment_original,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'income'
                    then amount_base_effective
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        )
        -
        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type in ('expense', 'adjustment')
                    then amount_base_effective
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as result,

        coalesce(
            sum(
                case
                    when transaction_type = 'transfer'
                    then amount_base_effective
                    else 0
                end
            ),
            0
        ) as transfers,

        count(*)::bigint as count,

        count(*) filter (
            where amount_base_effective is null
        )::bigint as missing_rate_count

    from converted_transactions
),

items as (
    select
        coalesce(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', x.id,
                    'transaction_type', x.transaction_type,
                    'account_id', x.account_id,
                    'account_name', x.account_name,
                    'amount_original', x.amount_original,

                    /*
                     * Backward-compatible field name,
                     * but value is now calculated correctly.
                     */
                    'amount_base', x.amount_base_effective,

                    'currency_original', x.currency_original,
                    'category_id', x.category_id,
                    'description', x.description,
                    'transaction_date', x.transaction_date
                )
                order by
                    x.transaction_date desc,
                    x.id desc
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) as transactions

    from converted_transactions x
)

select
    uc.user_id,
    uc.base_currency,

    '{{ $json.account_id }}'::text
        as account_id,

    '{{ $json.date_from }}'::date
        as date_from,

    '{{ $json.date_to }}'::date
        as date_to,

    {{ $json.include_descendants ? 'true' : 'false' }}::boolean
        as include_descendants,

    (
        select count(*)
        from scope_accounts
    )::bigint as account_scope_count,

    s.income as income,
    s.expense as expense,
    s.result as result,

    s.transfers,
    s.count,
    s.missing_rate_count,

    uc.base_currency as summary_currency,

    i.transactions

from user_ctx uc
cross join summary s
cross join items i;
